B0F5LNYTR7.title: Tapo Smart Wi-Fi Power Strip, Matter, P316M, Energy Monitoring
bullets: 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐔𝐩 𝐭𝐨 𝟗 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐎𝐧𝐜𝐞 - Connects and surge protects 6 individually controlled smart AC outlets and 3 always-on USB ports (5V 2.4A) for simultaneous, smart power across home or office setups.
𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐄𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐲 𝐔𝐬𝐞 & 𝐂𝐮𝐭 𝐂𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐬 - Monitor energy consumption for each AC outlet with comprehensive insights, and save money by scheduling devices to turn off during inactive hours.
𝐒𝐥𝐢𝐦 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐓𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐒𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐬 - Features a flush-fitting plug for discreet placement behind furniture, including couches, and a 3-foot power cord for space saving placement.
𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 - Automatically shuts off the outlet when your device/s are fully charged, preventing overcharging and extending battery life.

𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫-𝐂𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 - Matter-certified devices, regardless of brand, can work together and are can be controlled through most major smart home platforms like Alexa, Google Home, Apple HomeKit, and Samsung SmartThings.
𝐕𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥 - Easily control each of the AC outlets with voice commands via Siri, Alexa, Bixby, or Google Assistant.
𝐑𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥 - Manage each of the AC outlets anywhere using the Tapo app or your preferred smart home assistant. For best performance, make sure the firmware is updated by checking the Tapo app.
𝐋𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥 - Manage each of the AC outlets through your Tapo app via your local area network (LAN) for reliable operation, even during internet outages.
𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐒𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐝𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐬 & 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬 - Set automatic schedules to turn each of the AC outlets on/off based on your routine and preferences.

𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐂𝐲𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 - TP-Link is a signatory of the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency’s (CISA) Secure-by-Design pledge. This device is designed, built, and maintained, with advanced security as a core requirement.

specs.Special Feature: App Control, Energy Monitoring, On And Off Switch, Surge Protection, Usb Slot

B0H8Q1KJ13.title: Matter Smart Power Strip with USB-C 20W ETL listed FCC certified
bullets: Notes: 1. The order of the outlet buttons in the app does not match the order of the outlets on the power strip. We recommend connecting multiple times to adjust the order to your liking.

Matter certified – works with HomeKit, Alexa, and Google Home:One QR code connects to all three smart home platforms. Use Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant for voice control, or manage everything through the app and timers. No extra hub needed, no multiple apps to download – just scan and pair. Local control keeps your settings working even if the internet goes down.

Four independently controlled smart outlets – each one does its own thing:Each outlet can be turned on/off, set on a timer, or added to a scene separately. You can turn off the coffee maker while keeping the lamp on, or set the fan to turn off at midnight while your phone keeps charging. Control each outlet individually via the app, voice, or schedule.

2 USB‑C ports (20W total PD) + 2 USB‑A ports – charge 4 devices at once Use the 20W USB‑C PD port for fast charging your phone, while the other USB‑C port and two USB‑A ports handle your watch, earbuds, and power bank. One power strip powers everything on your nightstand.

ETL & UL certified with built‑in surge protection:This power strip meets North American safety standards with both ETL and UL certifications. The built‑in surge protection helps prevent voltage spikes from damaging your connected devices. Safety you can rely on.

No Hub Required – Works Right out of the Box:No Zigbee hub, no extra app to download, no complicated setup. Just plug it in, scan the Matter QR code with your phone, and you’re done. Local control keeps everything running smoothly even when the internet is offline.

specs.Special Feature: On And Off Switch, Remote Control, Surge Protection, Timer, Usb Slot

B0DYD7FKKB.title: Matter Smart Power Strip,Works with Apple HomeKit, Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant, with 4 Individually Controlled AC Outlets, Multi-Plug Extender for Home Office (Matter Upgrade -White)
bullets: 【Multi Compatibility】With Matter, the Users are no longer tied to specific platforms and works with all certified smart home platforms, such as Apple Home, Amazon Alexa, Google Home and SmartThiiings. You can control all your smart home devices from a single app, reducing the need for multiple apps for different devices.

【Fast Charging Type C & Smart Outlets】Equipped with 4 Smart AC outlets and 2 USB ports & 2 Type C fast chargers for home or office, supported for 8 appliances simultaneously. 4 Outlets can be controlled individual; 2 USB Ports & 2 Type Cs are controlled as a one unit. The maximum current through the power cord is 16A, and the maximum power used by the power strip is 3500W (can't be used for a long time).
【VOICE CONTROL】Works with Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant and Siri, simply send voice commands to Alexa or Google Assistant to control your home appliances through the smart outlet.

【Schedule and Timer Setting】 Flat extension cord with smart plug supports to set a schedule for the home or office devices; Ideal for aquarium light, bedside lamp, humidifier, and more appliances; Turn on/off at a specific time to save energy and reduce the electricity bill.

【All Round Safety Protection】Smart Surge protectors protect certificated by FCC, ETL listed, with built in safe guards to protect both the power strip and your charging devices form over-heat, over-charge, over-current, and short circuit, provide a safer using experience for UseeLink customer.

【About MATTER】MATTER protocol is led by major eco-platforms such as Apple, Google, Alexa, Samsung and more than 500 companies worldwide. No third-party apps to install, no cloud accounts to sign up for, no tracking required.

Note: When the matter power strip is connected to the APP for use, the order of the socket buttons on the APP corresponds to a different order of the power strip sockets. You can try to connect several times to adjust to the desired order, or name the controlled power strip socket on the APP.
